## Consent is legally load-bearing
`sms_consent` is only written `true` when the assistant got a clear spoken opt-in. A2P campaign **C8TKR2H** covers this number; texting without recorded consent puts it at risk.

The owner SMS goes to `OWNER_PHONE` — Anthony's own line — so it is not a customer message.

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1, 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb AS j)
INSERT INTO squeegee_leads
  (name, phone, email, address, services, property_type, timeline, source, status, sms_consent, sms_consent_timestamp)
SELECT j->>'name', j->>'phone', NULLIF(j->>'email', ''), NULLIF(j->>'address', ''),
       ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(j->'services')),
       NULLIF(j->>'property_type', ''), NULLIF(j->>'timeline', ''), 'voice_agent', 'new',
       coalesce((j->>'sms_consent')::boolean, false), NULLIF(j->>'consent_at', '')::timestamptz
FROM p
RETURNING id;
